title: Characterize C*=m including nonattainment of the infimum
statement: C*(d,m,eta)=m IFF eta>=delta(d,m). Sufficiency uses the exact empirical-excess theorem. For any universal policy of worst-case mean<=m, the prior stopped-KL floor gives E N_Q=m,E N_P=0; equality of transcript and exact-output KL forces fresh-Q and output histograms identical, first for positive laws via countable-dense likelihood ratios then by continuity. Thus uniform P=Q requires mismatch>=delta. To exclude an unattained infimum m below delta, collapse finite algorithms to stochastic next-action policies on countably many finite histories, take a diagonal compactness subsequence from worst means m+1/n, and use uniform Markov tails/Fatou to preserve a.s. termination, exact output, retention and mean<=m. Possibly noncomputable limit transitions are a lower-bound relaxation only, never an implementation oracle. Compute delta by a finite rational binomial sum; (1-1/d)/sqrt(1+6m(d-1)/d^2)<=delta<=sqrt((d-1)/(2m)). For d=2,delta=binom(2m,m)/4^m; at eta1/8 the threshold is m21. Supplied finite fraction checks are diagnostics, not the proof. Positive excess above m remains open.
